ValidationRule.description: When “Vended” is selected in the "Vended/Unvended" field on IMLA opportunity, at least one competitor should be added to the opportunity.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "IME_Custom Sys Admin", $Profile.Name <> "IME_Super_User", $Profile.Name <> "IM_Custom Sys Admin", IM_Has_Competitors__c = false, ISPICKVAL( IME_Vended_Unvended__c, "Vended"), RecordTypeId = "01280000000UEfu", ISNEW() = False, ISCHANGED(IM_Number_of_Opty_Products__c)= false, ISCHANGED( Pricebook2Id) = false, NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission))
